articles_applied: V (fail closed but not universal rejector)
XXXI (every correction creates a memory artifact)
XXXIV (stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck)

cemetery_entry_created.frozen_lesson: FROZEN THEOREM: 'AI + existing measurements' is not enough. A world-class invention needs a genuinely new technical information source, transformation, or control capability. Do not build an AI layer on top of an already-claimed sensing/control architecture. The Hakim patent family (WO2020086847A1) already claims: CSF pressure + venous pressure + differential + continuous monitoring + closed-loop valve control + IIH treatment. Adding phenotype classification on top of these same measurements is a new LABEL applied to existing measurements, not a new MEASUREMENT. Per Article XXVIII, passing the prior-art gate does not grant credit at the invention gate.
what_to_avoid: Do not propose AI classification of physiological variables already measured and controlled by existing patent claims.
Do not assume 'measuring the same thing for a different purpose' constitutes a new technical effect.
Do not propose CGRP as a pre-treatment discriminator without acknowledging conflicting evidence.
Do not propose a salvage treatment pathway without establishing the salvage treatment works.
cemetery_entry_created.cgrp_correction: CGRP as the proposed discriminator is NOT PERMANENTLY KILLED. The correct classification is 'not presently established.' A single negative/limited study kills that specific evidentiary basis, not the entire biomarker category. Future evidence may re-open CGRP if: (a) a larger study finds significance, (b) CGRP is combined with other biomarkers, or (c) CGRP is measured in a different compartment (CSF vs serum).

orthogonal_state_variable_discovery.question: What important failure phenotype information remains invisible even to the self-adjusting-valve architecture?
what_hakim_already_observes: Effective differential pressure (Pei = Pcsf - Pp) — calculated
Closed-loop valve adjustment — responds to differential
what_hakim_does_NOT_observe: Venous sinus wall COMPLIANCE (dV/dP — mechanical property)
ICP WAVEFORM MORPHOLOGY (P1/P2/P3 peak relationships — shape, not value)
Arachnoid granulation FUNCTION (CSF absorption capacity — structural)
Biochemical state (CSF composition, inflammatory markers — molecular)

orthogonal_candidates_discovered.name: Venous sinus compliance (dV/dP)
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.description: The mechanical property of the venous sinus wall — how much it distends per unit pressure change. This is a DIFFERENT physical quantity from pressure itself.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.why_orthogonal: Hakim measures PRESSURE (Pcsf, Pp) but NOT compliance (dV/dP). Compliance describes how the sinus wall RESPONDS to pressure, not what the pressure IS. A stiffer sinus (low compliance) may respond differently to stenting than a compliant sinus (high compliance).
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.evidence: Lazzaro 2012 (Neurosurgery): 'Venous sinus waveform pulsatility may in part be a function of the sinus wall compliance. Two factors contribute to venous sinus compliance: distensibility of...'
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.measurable: Potentially via MR elastography, cine MRV with pressure-volume curves, or intravascular ultrasound during catheter venography.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.relationship_to_R2_C3: HYPOTHESIS — patients with low venous sinus compliance may have stiffer sinuses that are less responsive to stenting → higher R2-C3 rate. This is UNTESTED.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.patent_landscape: NOT searched — would need a patent search for 'venous compliance measurement' or 'sinus wall distensibility' to determine if this measurement is already claimed.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.classification: DISCOVERY CANDIDATE — genuinely orthogonal signal, NOT validated, NOT promoted

orthogonal_candidates_discovered.name: ICP waveform morphology (P1/P2/P3 peak relationships)
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.description: The SHAPE of the ICP pulse waveform — the relative heights of the percussion (P1), tidal (P2), and dicrotic (P3) peaks. This is different from the absolute pressure value.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.why_orthogonal: Hakim measures pressure VALUES (Pcsf, Pp) but NOT waveform SHAPE. The P1/P2 ratio is a compliance indicator: if P2 > P1, brain compliance is lost. This information is INVISIBLE to a system that only measures mean/peak pressure.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.evidence: PMC8599247: 'Morphology of ICP waveform is important because P1 and P2 relation describes brain compliance.' J Neurosurg 2022: 'P1, P2, P3 peaks — normal conditions P1 > P2 > P3.' AACN: 'ICP pulse waveform is a unique predictor of disproportionate increases in ICP.'
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.measurable: Via continuous ICP monitoring (Rickham reservoir, intraparenchymal sensor) with waveform analysis. Ahmed 2011 used Rickham reservoir in 3 patients — this capability EXISTS but is not routine.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.relationship_to_R2_C3: HYPOTHESIS — patients with abnormal P1/P2 ratio (indicating lost brain compliance) may be more likely to develop R2-C3 (pressure-independent headache) because their brain compliance is already compromised, making pressure normalization insufficient to resolve symptoms. This is UNTESTED.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.patent_landscape: NOT searched — would need patent search for 'ICP waveform morphology' or 'P1/P2 ratio' in the context of IIH/shunt/VSS.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.classification: DISCOVERY CANDIDATE — genuinely orthogonal signal, NOT validated, NOT promoted

orthogonal_candidates_discovered.name: Arachnoid granulation function (CSF absorption capacity)
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.description: The functional capacity of arachnoid granulations to absorb CSF from the subarachnoid space into the venous system. This is a STRUCTURAL/FUNCTIONAL variable, not a pressure variable.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.why_orthogonal: Hakim measures pressures but NOT absorption capacity. Two patients with the same pressure but different absorption capacities may respond differently to stenting. Low absorption capacity → CSF accumulates despite normal pressure → R2-C3-like phenotype.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.evidence: PMC10649532 (Huda 2023): 'Arachnoid granulations are conduits for CSF resorption.' Headache 2024: 'Smaller AGs could result in lower CSF resorption, favoring development of IIH.'
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.measurable: Via contrast-enhanced MRV with granulation visualization, or infusion study (CSF infusion test measuring absorption rate). NOT routinely measured in VSS workup.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.relationship_to_R2_C3: HYPOTHESIS — patients with reduced arachnoid granulation function may have impaired CSF absorption that persists after VSS → R2-C3 (headache despite pressure normalization because absorption remains impaired). This is UNTESTED.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.classification: DISCOVERY CANDIDATE — genuinely orthogonal signal, NOT validated, NOT promoted

orthogonal_candidates_discovered.name: Autonomic state (HRV, sympathetic tone)
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.description: The state of the autonomic nervous system as measured by heart rate variability or other autonomic markers.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.why_orthogonal: Hakim measures intracranial pressures but NOT systemic autonomic state. Autonomic dysfunction may influence venous tone, CSF dynamics, and headache mechanisms independently of pressure.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.evidence: No IIH-specific HRV studies found in the search. HRV is established in stroke and brain injury but NOT in IIH.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.relationship_to_R2_C3: HYPOTHESIS — patients with autonomic dysfunction may have venous tone dysregulation that contributes to R2-C3. This is UNTESTED.
orthogonal_candidates_discovered.classification: DISCOVERY CANDIDATE — potentially orthogonal, UNTESTED in IIH, NOT promoted

discovery_summary.strongest_candidate: OSV-2 (ICP waveform morphology) — because: (a) it is a well-established clinical signal in neurocritical care (TBI), (b) it measures a DIFFERENT physical quantity (shape vs value), (c) it has a known relationship to brain compliance, (d) it requires only continuous ICP monitoring (which exists clinically), (e) Ahmed 2011 already used Rickham reservoir (continuous ICP) in IIH patients — the measurement capability EXISTS.
discovery_summary.key_insight: The orthogonal variables share a common theme: they all relate to COMPLIANCE (the mechanical response of tissue to pressure) rather than PRESSURE (the force itself). The Hakim patent measures pressure and controls a valve. It does NOT measure compliance. A system that measures compliance (venous sinus compliance, brain compliance via P1/P2, or CSF absorption compliance via granulation function) would observe information that is INVISIBLE to the Hakim architecture.
discovery_summary.frozen_lesson_from_kill: The kill of R2-C3-PREDICTOR-v1 produced a reusable theorem: 'AI + existing measurements is not enough.' The orthogonal search applies this theorem by seeking NEW measurements, not new analyses of old measurements.

verdict.candidate_classification: DISCOVERY HYPOTHESIS — NOT promoted. All orthogonal candidates are at HYPOTHESIS stage. No evidence, no model, no validation, no conclusion.

verdict.predictor_discovery_gate: RED for v1 (killed); YELLOW for orthogonal candidates (discovery stage)
next_moves: 1. The orthogonal candidates (especially OSV-2 ICP waveform morphology) are DISCOVERY HYPOTHESIS only. They require: (a) patent search for 'ICP waveform' / 'compliance measurement' / 'P1/P2 ratio', (b) literature search for any study using these variables in IIH/VSS, (c) evidence that the variable predicts R2-C3 or any failure phenotype.

2. The patent landscape for orthogonal variables has NOT been searched. Before any promotion, a full patent attack must be run on 'ICP waveform morphology for patient selection' and 'venous compliance measurement for treatment selection.'

3. Per Article XXXIV: the autonomous loop is approaching the boundary of what zero-cost analysis can establish. The orthogonal variables are genuinely new signal sources, but validating them requires data that does not exist in any open cohort.

5. Per Article V: the system is NOT a universal rejector. The kill of v1 produced a reusable theorem. The orthogonal search applied that theorem. A new candidate (v2) based on an orthogonal variable MAY survive if it demonstrates a new technical effect.
